stories.title: BofA Issues Stark Warning on Fed Rate Hikes
stories.summary: Bank of America issued a warning about the impact of Fed rate hikes, Yahoo Finance reports. The report gives few details beyond the warning itself.

stories.title: France Sees Record Debt in 2026, Near 120% of GDP
stories.summary: France's finance ministry expects government debt to hit a record in 2026, close to 120% of GDP, Investing.com reports. The forecast points to growing pressure on French public finances.
stories.whyItMatters: High French debt raises questions about fiscal risk and bond market stability across the euro area.
whatToWatch: France's 2026 budget process.
Reaction from ratings agencies and bond investors.
questions: How will France fund the higher debt load?
Will the debt level affect France's credit rating?

stories.whyItMatters: Buffett's exit from the chairman role marks a milestone in a succession question investors have tracked for years.

stories.whyItMatters: A Canada-India trade deal would open new market access for exporters in both countries.

A signed deal before year-end.

stories.title: Oil Flows Through Hormuz Hit 6-Month High After US Mine Clearance
stories.summary: Oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz reached a six-month high, CENTCOM said. It credited the rise to U.S. mine-clearance work, Investing.com reports.
stories.whyItMatters: The Strait of Hormuz is a narrow route for global oil shipments. Higher flows ease supply worries and can weigh on oil prices.
whatToWatch: Whether flows keep rising.
Any new security incidents in the strait.
questions: When were the mines placed, and by whom?
Does the higher flow rate change oil price forecasts?

sources.title: Hormuz oil flows hit 6-month high as U.S. mine clearance pays off, CENTCOM says

stories.title: Flames and Smoke Reported Near Riyadh Airport After Attack Warning
stories.summary: Witnesses reported flames and smoke near Riyadh's airport after Saudi Arabia warned of a threat of aerial attack, Investing.com reports. Details on the cause remain limited.
stories.whyItMatters: A security incident near a major Saudi airport can jolt oil markets, given the kingdom's role as a top crude exporter.
whatToWatch: Official word on the cause.
Any Saudi government or oil-market response.
questions: What caused the flames and smoke?
Was the airport or oil infrastructure affected?

stories.whyItMatters: A tie-up would link a major U.S. asset manager with one of Europe's largest infrastructure investors, a sign of continued consolidation in the sector.
whatToWatch: Whether the two firms reach a formal agreement.
Deal terms and size, if announced.
questions: What stake size is Ares considering?
